At the top centre, where the path ends, a flat, empty, round open space of beaten pale earth (an empty threshing-floor site, nothing on it). A few silver-green olive trees, rocks and bushes between and around the terraces at the edges, and far in the background along the top edge rolling hills and the golden-limestone city wall of Jerusalem in the distance. No buildings in the fields, no people, no animals, no crops.
